direct_runtime_dependency.manifest_proof: package.json declares axios in production dependencies; both paired versions satisfy ^1.9.0 and only the direct Axios package root changes between sides.

experiment.agent_task: Call the frozen get_items Tool and report only its returned result.
experiment.external_boundary: Container-local IPv6 loopback target [::1]:18081 and HTTP proxy 127.0.0.1:18082; target and proxy emit distinct RSS feed titles.

mcp_path_review.dependency_api: source/src/index.ts:113-150 fetchRssItems validates the Tool URL and calls axios.get(url) at :121-127 before rss-parser parses response.data
mcp_path_review.fixed_blocking: Axios 1.15.0 normalizes the IPv6 loopback host for NO_PROXY matching, connects to the direct target, and returns GH_P5_045_DIRECT_FEED_READBACK instead of the proxy-derived title
mcp_path_review.handler_path: source/src/index.ts:76-95 tool listing and :175-218 CallToolRequestSchema handler
mcp_path_review.sink_readback: The formattedItems[0].title value in the get_items JSON Tool result; the shared Host projects the exact same role=tool content into model.next_request
mcp_path_review.vulnerability_derived_state: GH_P5_045_PROXY_FEED_READBACK, a feed title emitted only by the controlled proxy boundary and absent from the frozen input
mcp_path_review.vulnerability_path: MCP get_items(url) -> fetchRssItems -> vulnerable Axios NO_PROXY normalization bypass for IPv6 loopback -> configured local HTTP proxy response -> rss-parser feed title -> formatted get_items Tool result

vulnerability.summary: Axios NO_PROXY hostname normalization bypass can route a protected loopback request through a configured proxy and expose the proxy response.
